title: AFPS pinned.set event data
description: CloudEvent `data` payload for `pinned.set` — an upsert-by-key into a named pinned slot emitted by the AFPS `pin()` tool (@afps/pin). Last-write-wins per (scope, key).

key.description: Pinned slot identifier. "checkpoint" is reserved for the carry-over slot.

content.description: Arbitrary JSON value stored under the pinned slot.

scope.description: AFPS persistence scope. Absent MUST be read as "actor" (per-actor isolation), never as "shared".
